How do you think the different objects on the stage should react when the bouncy ball hits them?

1. Start by making the ball bounce around the screen forever when the green flag is clicked.
2. Using conditionals, when the bell touches the ball, make the bell swing back and forth (by turning) and ring four times.
3. When the ball touches the lightning, make the lightning hit the ground and then make a thunder sound. Once the sound is done, make the lightning go back to the cloud.
4. When the chick touches the ball, make the chick move 5 steps forward (bouncing off the edge if necessary) and then make a chirp sound.
